title: I love flannel, but not these sheets
text: I love flannel, but not these sheets. These sheets may be fine for some people, but they were awful for me, and I love flannel sheets! They were a beautiful color (see advertised photo), and very soft, but washing them before use proved to be disastrous. The flannel just shed uncontrollably and was "beyond the pale" for flannel sheets. I have no problem with some shedding during the first wash, but this was so much, much worse. Maybe I just got a bad set of sheets, but I don't want to try this again. I returned the sheets for a refund.
